angle.hook: Ghost Ship opens Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core to everyone free on Steam until Mon 16 Nov 22:00 Dubai, six months after launch
angle.why_now: Ghost Ship's Steam announcement 'Rogue Core's FREE WEEKEND is here' (12 Nov 18:01Z) marks six months of early access; the Steam page shows free play 12 Nov 18:00Z to 16 Nov 18:00Z and a weekend deal to 26 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf PC players can try the co-op shooter free until Monday 22:00 Dubai; the UAE Steam store shows AED 39.50 (79.00 normal); Arabic is not a Steam language (not claimed)
angle.payoff: free until Monday 22:00 Dubai, 50% off (AED 39.50) to 26 Nov
